author: TeIq
content:
Epic state: SUBSTANTIAL PROGRESS, partial closure pending follow-ups.

## Landed
- #106 Q-resolution (all 5 questions answered with provisional decisions)
- #107 PR 1: read-only peer-Firehose subscription + signature verify + federation_quarantine table (production-shaped, opt-in via POLARIS_FEDERATION_ENABLED)
- #108 PR 2: 6-state EscalationState machine + 4 case-store tables + cancel-safe promotion worker
- #109 PR 3: OutboundPublisher::publish_escalation + polaris-federation-escalate admin binary + 5 privacy-boundary tests
- #110 PR 4 (PARTIAL): escalationMessage lexicon + types + lexicon_mapping bridge + publish_escalation_message method + mapping-matrix doc row. Inbound materialization + frontend UI deferred to #175.

## Deferred to follow-up sub-issues
- #175: escalationMessage inbound NSID routing + materialize_message_from_quarantine + case-view DTO + frontend FederationThread UI
- #176: federation metrics counters + polaris-federation-status admin binary + sig-failure WARN alerting
- #177: two-instance fixture integration tests covering AC-1..AC-8

## Why the partial closes
Sub-agent worktrees consistently branched off pre-PR-1 base (81e8217). The agents re-implemented #107-#109 from scratch in their worktrees, producing parallel-reality files incompatible with main's actual #107-#109. Bottom-half work (wire format, types, mapping, individual additive functions) merged cleanly; full-stack work (admin binaries depending on incompatible repo functions, integration tests depending on incompatible state machine) requires re-authoring against main's surface — tracked as the 3 follow-up sub-issues above.

Federation infrastructure is OPERATIONAL: an operator can configure peers, the worker subscribes + verifies + quarantines, the state machine validates transitions, the promoter materializes verified records, and the admin can publish outbound escalations. The remaining work is the inbound message materialization (#175), observability surface (#176), and integration-test coverage (#177).
